Let's say I purchased $DOGE and made $5k in profits, that I reinvest into $BTC.

On Blockfolio, adding a sell transaction for $DOGE and then a buy transaction on $BTC double counts your money. 

It doesn't recognize that the $5K you sold in $DOGE is the same 5K in $BTC now

in hindsight, this looks funny
